Who first told you that you couldn't do it?

Kevin Trudeau says many of us carry a program from childhood. A parent said "you can't, you're too dumb," and the doubt has been running in the background ever since.

He points to Henry Ford: whether you believe you can or believe you can't, either way you're right. The thinking makes it so.

Kevin adds that the people we admire most for their results said the same thing: you have to believe in your dream and in yourself.

What is one doubt you picked up long ago that you still carry?

#ad #mindset #success #belief

Most people never do step one of getting what they want.

Kevin Trudeau lays out a simple formula. First, get fed up with something so much that you have to move. Second, decide exactly what you want, with a burning desire for it.

Then see yourself in possession of it and feel it now. Finally, let go of attachment to the outcome and hold the same feeling.

He says it takes about ten seconds and can be done many times a day.

What are you truly fed up with right now?
